curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What do eight former members reveal about how the Church of Scientology attracts true believers?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Alex Gibney, this documentary profiles eight former members of the Church of Scientology, examining how people are drawn into the organization and what they do once inside.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, serious, and deeply reflective solo viewing that demands engaged attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The film focuses on eight former Church of Scientology members while examining how the organization attracts true believers.

facts.title: Going Clear: Scientology and the Prison of Belief
